fields.summary_ko.0: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Corporation (NYSE:TSM) rose 14.5% on news of Jensen Huang's return as Nvidia CEO, with 68% of revenue coming from AI data center chips.
fields.summary_ko.1: TSMC is Nvidia's exclusive manufacturing partner, accounting for 19% of 2025 revenue, and produces over 90% of the world's advanced chips.
fields.summary_ko.2: The stock maintains a reasonable valuation at a P/E of 23.6, with AI chip demand exceeding supply in a positive environment.
